description.value: Le Petit Saigon is a Vietnamese restaurant on East Hastings Street in Vancouver's east side, offering both dine-in and takeout service with delivery available. It sits along a busy arterial corridor that connects central Vancouver to outer eastside neighbourhoods, making it a potential refuelling stop for cyclists passing through.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces, covered) at 45m; stands (4 spaces, covered) at 77m. Total: 6 spaces.
